title: Isandro and the Gravity
author: Noor Dravenmoor
blurb: Theo Underhill, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
